hero.description: Photograph showing Sheikh Mujibur Rahman (also known as "Bangabandhu") delivering his historic speech "7 March Speech of Sheikh Mujibur Rahman" on 7 March 1971 at the then Ramna Race Course (now Suhrawardy Udyan), Dhaka, East Pakistan (now Bangladesh). The mass gathering can be seen behind him, as he raised his hand in address. This speech is widely regarded as the de-facto proclamation of Bangladesh’s struggle for independence.
